argument_summary: The admissible record supports certification only on a limited basis. Aggregate readiness passed by 2.3 points, the rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and the rollout includes staged deployment, monitoring, and rollback. Those facts support operational containment, but they do not support a clean claim that controls alone satisfy governance because the rideshare safety support segment remains below target, remains exposed in the initial cohort, and is not covered by an approved risk acceptance record. The supportable position is therefore weak, caveated certification that expressly preserves the unresolved limitation and disclosure obligation rather than escalation based on a misread clean-certification theory.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is offered as a policy substitute. The defense does not rely on launch velocity or operational preference to satisfy governance requirements.
claims_about_policy: The controlling policy cuts against a clean certification argument: when the affected use case remains exposed, rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. The admissible evidence does not show approved risk acceptance for the rideshare safety support exposure. At the same time, the policy does not require treating aggregate readiness, absence of severity-one incidents, and containment controls as irrelevant; they remain supporting context for a weakly supported certification posture, provided the audit packet characterizes the decision as caveated rather than fully compliant on controls alone.
concessions: The rideshare safety support segment is below target on incident-report prioritization and remains eligible in the initial rollout cohort.
The randomized city-market gate does not exclude the affected segment.
The available risk acceptance draft is incomplete, unapproved, and does not address the rideshare exposure.
The current admissible record does not support a clean certification finding based on rollout controls alone.
Required model-card disclosure remains the key unresolved governance condition on this record.
